snippet.title: Video Store Chaos - Release Trailer
snippet.description: Video Store Chaos is a single-player simulation. Pick up, sort and shelve over 2,500 movie, game and VHS cases to turn a messy video store into an organized collection. Unlock upgrades to carry more and work faster, find clues on the covers and explore the hidden basement.
